description: AGNI is an independent participant in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. I aim to explore solutions to real-world challenges through technology, research, and creative problem-solving. As a Computer Science and Engineering student interested in space exploration and software development, I hope to combine technical knowledge with creativity to develop an informative and engaging solution. My objective is to learn, innovate, and contribute a meaningful project aligned with the challenge's goals.
summary:
SPACE LEGACY is an interactive storytelling website that explores the human-made equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars after space missions.

The project highlights the stories of the Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicle, the Sojourner rover from Mars Pathfinder, and NASA's Opportunity rover. Through mission stories, photographs, timelines, and status information, visitors can learn why these machines were sent into space, what they accomplished, and what happened when their missions ended.

Using NASA mission information and imagery, SPACE LEGACY presents space exploration history in an engaging and accessible way. It aims to raise awareness of the scientific achievements, historical significance, and lasting legacy of these machines, reminding us that a mission's impact can continue long after the spacecraft stops operating.

Technologies used: HTML,CSS,JAVASCRIPT
details:
SPACE LEGACY is a responsive, interactive website designed to tell the stories of space exploration equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars.

The website focuses on three missions: Apollo 15 and its Lunar Roving Vehicle, Mars Pathfinder and its Sojourner rover, and the Mars Exploration Rover Opportunity. Visitors can explore dedicated Moon and Mars sections, read mission stories, view photographs, follow a historical timeline, and learn about the current status and legacy of these machines.

The project uses HTML to structure the website, CSS for its visual design and responsive layouts, and JavaScript for interactive features such as mobile navigation, expandable stories, and scroll animations.

Its creative approach is to present abandoned space equipment not simply as discarded objects, but as important witnesses to human exploration and scientific progress. The project aims to make mission history easier to understand and encourage visitors to appreciate the achievements of earlier space missions.

NASA mission information and imagery were used as primary resources. The photographs used are NASA-sourced, not AI-generated.
